text:
Priya: Quick ask — candidate for SWE IC3 on Thu (9:00am PT) needs a panel tweak. Jordan flagged a conflict. Can someone swap or can we move to 11:00am PT? Also quick rubric Q: technical score scale 10 or 5? cc @Samir Patel @Jordan @Elena Gonzalez

Samir Patel: I can cover 9am if needed. If we move to 11am that works too. For rubric, we've historically done tech=10, behavior=5 but let me check new hiring guidance.

Jordan: Sorry team — 9am collides with a client call I can't move. 11am PT works for me. If we move, candidate is ET so it's 2pm ET for them — should be fine? I'm happy to be debrief lead if I attend.

Maya K: I'm flexible. If Jordan takes 11am I'm happy to take the 9am spot as backup. Also can whoever edits the calendar set 'debrief lead: Jordan' so notes route correctly.

Elena Gonzalez: Small rubric note — the interview guide suggests normalized scores: tech_out_of_10 and behavioral_out_of_5, then compute total normalized to 100. Should we just switch to two 10-point sections to simplify scoring? :thinking_face:

hire-bot: Reminder — debrief lead must submit debrief within 24h. Debrief template (paste into GDrive candidate folder):
```
- Overall recommendation: (hire / no hire / strong hire)
- Technical (0-10):
- Behavioral (0-5):
- Notes (bullets):
- Must-ask followups:
```
And required fields: 'debrief lead', 'interviewer list', 'candidate timezone'.

Priya: Thanks all. Plan: move to 11:00am PT, Jordan will be debrief lead. @Maya K you'll be backup if Jordan bails. I'll update the calendar invite, add the debrief template link, and set the rubric to tech=10, behavior=5 for this loop to match past hires. I'll post a short comment if we decide to standardize later.

Samir Patel: Sounds good. Quick ask — can we add a short eval sample to the candidate doc for consistency? I'll drop two exemplar answers.

Jordan: Great. Also quick logistics — please add Zoom host to invite (Elena) and set recording off. I'll leave a :thumbsup: reaction once updated.

Priya: Done — calendar updated, debrief lead set, invite notes include template and sample eval link: https://docs.internal/redwood/candidates/IC3-12345. Ping me if anything else.
